title: Zesty Earthy Syrian Vegetable Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious Syrian-inspired dish featuring a variety of vegetables in a rich vegetable stock, served in a hot dolsot stone bowl. This earthy bowl is perfect for a satisfying brunch.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the carrots, zucchini, eggplant, and red bell pepper into bite-sized pieces and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the vegetables and sprinkle with paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Broil the vegetables in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
In a large pot, bring the vegetable stock to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low and add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the pot.
Simmer the stock for 10 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together.
Add the broiled vegetables to the pot and stir to combine.
Divide the vegetable mixture among four dolsot stone bowls.
Serve the bowls hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
